promises.sentence: No route outside the declared public routes is reachable without signing in.

promises.basis: sign-in guard jwt_required (session key identity) on POST /api/articles
promises.sentence: Only a signed-in user can reach POST /api/articles.

requirements.text:
# What this app promises

- R1 [auth]: No route outside the declared public routes is reachable without signing in.
- R2 [auth]: Only a signed-in user can reach POST /api/articles.

workflow.text:
name: Assure

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  assure:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09 # v5

      - name: Set up Python 3.14
        uses: actions/setup-python@ece7cb06caefa5fff74198d8649806c4678c61a1 # v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.14"

      - name: Assure check
        id: assure
        uses: Symbolia-Assurance/assure-action@beta
        with:
          profile: python-auth-declared-model
          requirements: requirements.md

      - name: Keep the verdict
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7
        with:
          name: assure-verdict
          path: ${{ steps.assure.outputs.verdict-path }}
